info.title: pigateway API
info.description: The Pi device gateway: ATEM, cameras, the Atlona matrix (through the AMX master) and the Matrox Monarch HDX encoder. Writes under /api/v1 need X-Api-Key or a Bearer token unless the client is on PIGATEWAY_AUTH_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

get.summary: ATEM switcher connection and program/preview state

200.description: Current ATEM state (connected=false when no ATEM is configured)

post.summary: Auto (mix) transition of preview to program on the ATEM M/E row

200.description: Auto transition started; returns the new state

post.summary: Cut program and preview on the ATEM M/E row

200.description: Cut sent; returns the new state

put.summary: Put a downstream keyer on air or take it off (cut, like the ON AIR button)

200.description: Keyer updated; returns the new state

put.summary: Point a media player still at a downstream keyer

200.description: Set up; returns the ATEM state

put.summary: Set the tie of a downstream keyer (rides with the next transition)

200.description: Tie updated; returns the new state

post.summary: Fade to black on the ATEM M/E row (fades back in when already black)

200.description: Fade started; returns the new state

put.summary: Upload a raw RGBA still to the media pool (1-based slot)
Set the preview input on the ATEM M/E row

200.description: Preview set; returns the new state

422.description: Input is not a valid ATEM input number

put.summary: Set the program input on the ATEM M/E row

422.description: Input is not a valid ATEM input number

get.description: Returns all configured PTZ cameras with their current connection, streaming, and position state.

get.summary: Get details and status for a specific camera

post.description: Standard VISCA CAM_Focus auto or manual. Auto also ends a privacy blur. Not yet verified on a real PTZ330.

get.summary: Read the camera's FreeD output settings

502.description: The camera CGI did not answer or rejected the request

post.summary: Turn the camera's FreeD output on or off, optionally setting the target
post.description: Sends the FreeD target (when `target` is given) through the camera CGI, switches FreeD on or off, then reads the state back. Uses the camera's CGI port and login. Commands follow the camera web UI; not yet verified on a real PTZ330 beyond the read-back.

502.description: The camera CGI did not answer or rejected the request

post.description: Drives pan/tilt continuously or stops motion using VISCA over IP.

post.summary: Wake the camera or send it to standby
post.description: Standard VISCA CAM_Power. `on: true` wakes the camera from standby, `on: false` sends it to standby. The command leaves from UDP source port 52381 (configurable per camera). Tested on cam1 only.
Recalls a saved preset (0-254) on the camera via VISCA CAM_Memory.

post.summary: Save current camera position to preset
post.description: Saves the current position, zoom, and image state to a preset (0-254) via VISCA CAM_Memory Set.

post.summary: Capture a thumbnail for a camera preset

post.description: On switches the camera from autofocus to manual focus, sets the near focus limit to the closest distance and drives focus to the nearest point, so the picture is out of focus. Off restores the normal near limit (PIMATRIX_CAMERA_NEAR_LIMIT_M, default 1.5 m, unverified mapping) and returns the camera to autofocus. Uses standard VISCA focus commands; not yet verified on a real PTZ330.
Enables, disables, or triggers one-shot SmartFrame auto framing.

post.summary: Start video streaming from camera to MediaMTX
post.description: Commands the camera to push its RTMP feed to MediaMTX or ensures MediaMTX is pulling RTSP.
Drives optical zoom tele/wide or stops zoom using VISCA over IP.

get.summary: Gateway mode, device health, and latest PiVoice telemetry

200.description: Gateway status including latest PiVoice telemetry

get.description: Returns current gateway state. The pivoice object is the latest validated UDP telemetry snapshot, with connected/stale liveness flags.

checkedAt.description: Epoch ms on the sender's clock

ttlMs.description: How long the reading is good for

dsk.description: 1-based keyer number as printed on the switcher

privacyBlur.description: True while the privacy blur (manual focus driven near) is on.

true.description: true wakes the camera, false sends it to standby

camId.description: FreeD camera ID the camera sends (the web UI shows it, e.g. 101)

addr.description: Address the camera sends FreeD to

receivedAt.description: Epoch ms on the gateway's clock
